# Programming Logic . PRLD5121

Free focused revision pack. Suggested time: 45 minutes.

Trace, write and debug pseudocode.

Attempt every question before opening the answers. These are supplementary exercises, not a complete syllabus or an official exam.

## Question 1

Trace total = 0; FOR i = 1 TO 4; total = total + i; END FOR. Give each new total.

## Question 2

Write pseudocode to count marks of at least 50 in [45, 70, 50, 30].

## Question 3

Fix a WHILE loop that tests n < 5 but never changes n. Start n at 1.

## Question 4

Write a returning method that receives length and width.

## Question 5

Design a Student class with a name and marks. Explain encapsulation.
